feeds.title: National Elf Service
feeds.description: Welcome to the Mental Elf. Our website will help you find just what you need to keep up-to-date with all of the important and reliable mental health research and guidance.

feeds.title: Be Your Own Light
feeds.description: This blog is written by Eleanor Segall. Diagnosed with bipolar 1 disorder (a mood disorder) at 16, and now in her twenties, she blogs about what has helped her in recovery and tries to help others too.

feeds.title: Defying Mental Illness
feeds.description: Your one stop place for everything on mental health, emotional health, and living a life over and beyond! Author Eze (Chuck) shares his thoughts on the mental journey and Zoe shares hers on being a caregiver and more. They hope to help those contending with mental illness on their path to recovery & well-being.

feeds.title: Unwanted Life
feeds.description: I blog about my experiences with dyslexia, mental health, and physical health problems. I also offer my views and opinions on related subjects in the hopes It'll help other people, whilst further helping to destigmatize dyslexia, mental health, and physical health problems as well.

feeds.title: Mental Health Affects Someone Like Me
feeds.description: Mental Health Affects Someone Like Me - mhasl.me is a community blogging platform for all things mental health related. Readers and collaborations come together and share their stories around all areas of Mental Health including, personal accounts of mental health aliments, tips and tricks to manage with your mental health and support articles.

feeds.title: Fiona Thomas Blog
feeds.description: I'm Fiona Thomas.I'm a freelance writer with work published on Metro, Healthline, Heads Together, Mind, Reader's Digest and Happiful magazine.

feeds.title: Support Room Blog
feeds.description: Support Room is a mental health counseling platform providing mental health support online via text chat, video calls, and voice notes with therapists. Read our blog articles with information and guides on mental health related issues and find solutions to these problems from qualified therapists.

feeds.title: Creative Steph Blog
feeds.description: Steph has been using creativity to help manage the symptoms of multiple mental Illnesses and chronic pain for nearly 2 years. Through her website and blog she promotes good mental health practices and creative ideas and as part of her 'Creative Coping Strategies' campaign she regularly provides inspiration for ways others can do the same. Her blog includes lived experience of acute agoraphobia (she's been indoors for over a year) as well as nearly a decade living with crippling social anxiety, panic disorder, BPD and more recently mild Tourette's.

feeds.title: Sanity Daily Blog
feeds.description: Priyanka Joshi is a top mental health blogger, dedicated to helping individuals achieve optimal mental health and well-being. Her blog Sanity Daily is all about providing practical tips, insights, and evidence-based strategies to help individuals improve their mental health and well-being. Explore more mental health issues and challenges in new posts.

feeds.title: Student Minds Blog
feeds.description: The Student Minds blog is the UK's one of the biggest blogs on student wellbeing and mental health, sharing student experiences of mental health difficulties. It is the UK's student mental health charity. We empower students and members of the university community to look after their own mental health, support others and create change.

feeds.title: Medium
feeds.description: The Stress, Psychiatry and Immunology Laboratory (SPI Lab) is an academic research laboratory within King's College London, led by Professor Carmine Pariante. Our team is made up of clinicians, research and postgraduate students who work across a range of clinical settings.

feeds.title: Bravely She Blogs
feeds.description: Hey, I'm Kimberlee and I'm so happy you're here! I live on a narrowboat and roam and write while exploring the beautiful English countryside. I blog about living with Major Depressive Disorder, PTSD, Addiction Recovery.

feeds.title: Anxious Minds
feeds.description: Anxious Minds is dedicated in providing education and support for people suffering from anxiety and depression. Mental Health Forum and training platform for you the user so why not get involved and help it grow you're not alone when your part of Anxious Minds.

feeds.title: My Possible Self Blog
feeds.description: Mental Health Blog. Features mental health news & tips, engaging activities, mental exercises, and provides information and advice on all things wellbeing. My Possible Self is the mental health app using clinically certified content from Priory Healthcare to help reduce anxiety, stress, and low mood.

feeds.title: The Looneychick Blog
feeds.description: This is an award-winning blog featuring real life stories about people who suffer from mental health illnesses.

feeds.title: Balance Life Well Blog
feeds.description: Passionate about empowering positive Mental Health and Mental Wellbeing.

feeds.title: Sadness and Wanderlust Blog
feeds.description: This is a blog where I will write about everything from depression to dreams, eating disorders to exploring the world.

feeds.title: Monkey Minds Blog
feeds.description: My name is Katy and I'm 33. I am from the north east of England but am currently in Thailand where it's warm. I've suffered from anxiety and depression for nearly twenty years. I'm writing this blog to help myself and others -both those who are suffering with mental illness, and those who aren't but would like to understand a bit more about what it's like to have a crowd of monkeys and their extended families living in your brain.

feeds.title: My Musings & Me
feeds.description: Welcome to My Musings and Me. My name is Emma and I'm a mental health educator. I use my experience and knowledge running mental health training, sessions and discussion groups to write this blog. I'm passionate about exploring new ways to boost our mental health and wellbeing. And educating about mental health to raise awareness.

feeds.title: Gracie Francesca Blog
feeds.description: Grace shares her story on problems that all young people face, as well as topics that are perceived taboo, by speaking openly about mental health and other personal battles in UK. Grace's content has a focus on plus size fashion, body positivity and the importance of self-care. She also regularly attends inspirational meetings with young women to give advice, guidance and a chance to share each other's stories.

feeds.title: The Harley Psychology Group Blog
feeds.description: The British CBT & Counselling Service are Doctors of Psychology specialising in CBT for adults, families & children. Follow this blog to get a clear understanding of the origins and development of problems and learn comprehensive techniques to eliminate these and prevent their return.

feeds.title: Nyxie's Nook
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Chloe, more widely known as Nyxie online. I'm a twenty-something cat mum with a passion for writing, illustrating & video games. My writing is predominantly focused on mental health, general wellness & eating disorder recovery. This list has evolved over time & I've been known to take on book reviews, interior advice (in regards to mental wellness) & even articles on pet care.

feeds.title: Mental Health UK Blog
feeds.description: Covers Mental Health Conditions, Mental Health & Money, Workplace Mental Health, Young people's Mental Health, Government & Legislation, Campaigns, and Charity Partnerships. Mental Health UK works across England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland to support people affected by mental health problems.

feeds.title: Inspire the Mind
feeds.description: Inspire the Mind brings a different perspective from other mental health blogs: viewpoints of clinicians, researchers, and others working within mental health. We want to complement people's accounts by discussing the scientific evidence underpinning these personal experiences, while also sharing with our readers ongoing research and clinical work, discussion pieces, and the various links between culture and mental health.

feeds.title: Li Jean-Luc Harris
feeds.description: Li Jean-Luc Harris shares his stories about mental health, homelessness drug addictions and the foster care system.
